title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Teaching finance education to students 7847 views Q. Clarification regarding my previous question about payment of tax from Interest money. 2858 views Q. Please help us to find the right way in our life. I am a software engineer working for a software company. The focus of our software company is banking field and most of the clients are banks. The problem I am facing now is that the project that I am working is for banking software and the bank that I am working is not Islamic bank. The software that I develop or involved is used by the Bank to open account on-line through internet,applying on-line application for credit card, to view the Interest rates on internet for checking account, saving account and fixed deposits, etc.. I ask you to guide me whether doing work for a bank is haram (unlawful) even though I am not directly working for the bank and salary is given by my company, not the Bank. 2274 views Q. saving bank interst 1954 views
answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 61852 Country: India Title: Rendering Indirect service to banks Question: I run data entry business and I got a project related to bank, to enter customers data who is seeking services from bank. I will be paid indirectly that is through vendor who takes the tender from the bank and sub leases to data entry centers. Is it halal for me to do such kind of jobs? Answer ID: 61852 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 56/88/SN=02/1437) You may do so but if you avoid it, it is far better. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
